children: Canada natural sweetener supplier's Q2 revenue fell 19% yr/yr on lower prices and sales volumes
Q2 net loss of C$6.1 mln, reversing prior-year profit due to one-time gain last year
Gross profit margin rose to 22% from 15%, helped by product mix, tariff rebates, and FX gains
Company says competitive price pressures in stevia and monk fruit markets are expected to persist
Company warns that without new cash infusion, it may not realize strategic plans or remain a going concern
GLG Life Tech expects global macroeconomic uncertainty and signs of softened demand to impact near-term outlook
LOWER PRICES AND SALES VOLUMES - Co said Q2 revenue decline was mainly due to lower unit prices from market pricing pressures and reduced units sold
PRODUCT MIX AND TARIFF REBATES - Gross margin improvement attributed to more favorable mix of higher margin products, tariff rebates, and FX gains
COMPETITIVE PRICE PRESSURE - Co said stevia and monk fruit markets continue to face intense pricing competition, affecting mainstream and specialty products
